name: Roland FANTOM-6/7/8
description: Roland FANTOM-6, FANTOM-7 and FANTOM-8 workstations: the temporary scene (common, effects, and the zone, zone EQ and zone control blocks of all 16 zones) with zone 1's Z-Core tone, SN-A tone and drum kit, and the V-Piano tone. From the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: FANTOM-6/7/8 MIDI Implementation
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from FANTOM-6_7_8_MIDI_Imple_eng01_W.pdf (sha256 8b16ed3b916637e5255664171e4da9ad639cd7f4db2c9154b85854c9ffa2d6fd). Model ID 00 00 00 5B, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
One profile answers FANTOM-6, -7 and -8: they share the address map, the model id (00 00 00 5B) and the identity family code (5B 03); only the software revision tells them apart (p11).

Scene-level blocks for all 16 zones (Zone, Zone EQ, Zone Control); tones for zone 1 only: Z-Core at 02 10 00 00, drum kit at 02 30 00 00 with its instruments at 03 00 00 00, SN-A at 04 00 00 00, and the one V-Piano tone at 04 20 00 00.
Zone 1's drum-kit instruments cover keys 36-72; keys 21-35 and 73-108 are the same Inst blocks every 00 05 00 from 03 00 00 00 and are left out to keep the profile near 12,000 parameters.
The EXSN tones (05 00 00 00 + zone) are missing: the manual prints them below the closing border of the top table on p14, and the map stops at that border.

Many rows are printed without a number where they repeat: Name (16 bytes, as 16 rows), the two LFOs of a Partial LFO block, the 16 LFO steps, the four partials of a PMT, the four matrix controls of a partial, the four waves of a drum instrument. Their ids carry the address after the first.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what the front panel transmits (CC, RPN) is not in the address map
coverage.zoneTones: zone 1 only: Z-Core, SN-A and drum kit tones of zones 2-16 are the same tables at Z-Core 02 11 00 00 - 02 1F 00 00 (step 01 00 00), Drum Kit 02 32 00 00 - 02 4E 00 00 (step 02 00 00), Drum Kit Inst Set 03 04 00 00 - 03 3C 00 00 (step 04 00 00) and SN-A 04 01 00 00 - 04 0F 00 00 (step 01 00 00), and are not laid out
coverage.drumInstruments: zone 1's drum kit has every key's partial and partial EQ (keys 21-108); its instruments (Inst Common and the three Inst envelopes) only for keys 36-72. Keys 21-35 (03 00 00 00 - 03 00 46 00) and 73-108 (03 02 04 00 - 03 03 33 00) are left out
coverage.exsnTone: not laid out: the map read from the manual does not have the Temporary EXSN Tone entries (05 00 00 00 - 05 0F 00 00, p14), which the manual prints after the top table's closing border
coverage.pianoDesignerKeys: the V-Piano's per-key Level and Character tables have 128 entries each; the map holds only the first and the last, the two rows p54 prints. Piano Designer Tuning (04 20 04 00, 512 bytes) is not laid out: its reply is two 256-byte packets, which a one-message block dump cannot read
coverage.scenePresets: Scene banks A and B only: the Bank Select table (p1) continues past B with ":" and does not say how far
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX/IFX/TFX, chorus and reverb parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
